capabilities.runtime_test: Live swarm confirmed: Sub-APPROVED, Cart-SUPPRESSED_CONFLICT, Retention-SUPPRESSED_CONFLICT. BUT: winner does not change based purely on NIC when proposals arrive sequentially.
capabilities.evidence: CAVEAT: The gateway submits proposals ONE-AT-A-TIME to the arbitrator. The arbitrator correctly ranks by NIC (sort descending) when given all proposals simultaneously. But in practice, the first agent to hit the gateway locks the customer attention budget, making all subsequent agents SUPPRESSED regardless of their NIC. True multi-agent NIC-winner arbitration only works via the /simulate-collision endpoint, not when agents call separately.
